record.question: How will you deal with the following cases: (a) A Govt. servant placed under suspension dies before conclusion of disciplinary proceedings drawn against him. (b) A major penalty proceedings under Rule 14 drawn against a Govt. servant who was placed under suspension ended with imposition of minor penalty. (c) A charged official in a disciplinary case complained about the Inquiry Officer's bias in the conduct of inquiry. (d) A govt. servant placed under suspension seeks voluntary retirement from service. (e) A Govt. servant against whom a Disciplinary proceedings was drawn was due to retire from service on superannuation pension before conclusion of the Disciplinary Case.
